docuLanguageResource.title: Commission disburses €3.3 billion in defence funding to Ukraine
docuLanguageResource.subtitle: Commission disburses €3.3 billion in defence funding to Ukraine
docuLanguageResource.htmlContent:
The European Commission will today disburse €3.3 billion to Ukraine for defence procurement under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. The payment covers drones and missiles and will help Ukraine defend its territory and skies against Russia's ongoing aggression.

Ursula von der Leyen, President of the Commission: “Today, we will disburse €3.3 billion to help procure drones and missiles under the Ukraine Support Loan. Europe will continue to deliver the support Ukraine needs to defend its people and its territory.''
